title: Pablo Sarasqueta | Sales, Dublin
description: Pablo Sarasqueta, based in Dublin and looking for an SDR or BDR role. Founder of Explorandogs and HitDeporte. IBM-certified sales representative.
ogDescription: I started my first company at fifteen. The second one taught me how to sell.

hero.titleLead: I started my first company at fifteen.
hero.titleAccent: The second one taught me how to sell.
hero.intro: I'm Pablo, I live in Dublin, and I'm looking for an SDR or BDR role. Below is the business I built from nothing: I found the customers, sold them a trip, and looked after them until they were home.

explorandogs.title: Explorandogs
intro: A travel agency for people in Spain who wanted to take their pets on holiday around Europe, and couldn't find anyone to organise it.
There was no team, no budget and no customer list. Every booking went through the same seven stops, and I ran all of them.

guide.title: One client, one city, 22 pages.
guide.text: Every client got a guide written for their own trip. This one is for Rome: pet-friendly restaurants, transport, day trips, the nearest vets and practical tips for travelling with a dog.
guide.cardFooter: Written for one client and their dog

explorandogs.closing: Building the business meant doing everything around the sale as well: the Shopify website and its SEO, the brand and the social channels, and the numbers behind every trip.

hitDeporte.title: HitDeporte
hitDeporte.ageCaption: My age when I started it, in 2015
intro: A Spanish sports news site I started at fifteen, covering Spanish football, international football and other sports. It built a loyal readership in Spain and picked up readers around the world.

I couldn't write it all myself, so I recruited journalism students to join. Looking back, that was my first sales job: convincing people older than me to give their time to a project run by a teenager.

why.title: Why I think I'd be good at this
why.intro: Six things I'd bring to a sales team, and where each one comes from.

contact.title: If I were prospecting you, this is where I'd ask for fifteen minutes.
contact.intro: So I'm asking. If you're hiring SDRs or BDRs in Dublin, for English or Spanish-speaking markets, I'd like to hear about the role.
